QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Determination
QuestInfo.0:
Empress #p1101000# of #m130000000# invites you to become a member of the Maple Alliance. This isn't a decision you can make on your own.

#bHead to #m940202000# and talk with Morian and Sinaria.
QuestInfo.1: You go to #m940202000# and talk with Morian and Sinaria. Return to the Empress to tell her your decision.
QuestInfo.2: You accepted Empress #p1101000#'s proposition and became a member of the Maple Alliance. It was a little awkward but now you have people you can count on.
